### 🚀 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of what feature or enhancement you would like to see in Passli.

### 💡 Problem / Use Case
Describe the problem this feature solves (e.g. "When sharing multiple identity cards, I want...").

### 📐 Proposed Solution & UX Architecture
Detailed description of how you envision this feature working from a user and developer perspective.

### 🔒 Security Considerations
Explain how this feature maintains Passli's cryptographic boundaries and security model.

### 📌 Additional Context
Add any mockups, screenshots, or architectural notes.
